note: Example data: an invented online booking software company and invented trial records, not a real business. Every number in expected_output.json follows from this input.
request: Hey Claude, I just added the "trial-to-paid-optimizer" skill. Our 14-day free trial converts badly. Here's our Stripe subscriptions export joined to the day each account got its first client booking. Work out why trials don't pay and give me the plan.

business.name: Example Booking Software
business.product: online booking, reminders and payments for salons, clinics, studios and personal trainers

trial_setup.at_trial_end: account locks until a plan is picked
trial_setup.activation_definition: first booking made by a client through the account's booking page
trial_setup.sales_team: one customer success manager who can take 8 setup calls a week; no sales calls on trials today

billing_export.source: Stripe subscriptions and paid invoices export (uploaded CSV), joined by customer id to the product's first-client-booking date and the signup source

get_flow_report.timeframe: last_90_days, which is not the same span as the trial window
